title: Spectral Gaps of Hit-and-Run and Coordinate Hit-and-Run
abstract: arXiv:2608.16878v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For any convex body $\mathcal{K}\subset\mathbb{R}^{n}$ containing a unit ball, the spectral gap of Hit-and-Run is $\Omega(1/(n^2 C_{\mathsf{PI}}))$, where $C_{\mathsf{PI}}$ is the Poincar\'e constant of the uniform distribution $\pi$ over $\mathcal{K}$. This implies that Hit-and-Run converges to a distribution within $\chi^2$-divergence $\varepsilon$ of the uniform distribution $\pi$ in $O(n^2 C_{\mathsf{PI}}\log(M/\varepsilon))$ steps from any starting distribution $\pi_0$ with $M=\chi^2(\pi_{0}\,\|\,\pi)$, thus refining the known bound of $O(n^2 R^2 \log(M/\varepsilon))$ by Lov\'asz and Vempala (2004) in terms of the outer radius $R$; for nearly isotropic bodies, together with progress on the KLS conjecture, the complexity is $O(n^2\log n\log(M/\varepsilon))$, improving the dimension dependence from cubic to nearly quadratic while maintaining logarithmic dependence on the initial distance. translated_title: 击中-逃跑与坐标击中-逃跑的谱间隙
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16878v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对于任意包含单位球的凸体 $\mathcal{K}\subset\mathbb{R}^{n}$，击中-逃跑算法的谱间隙为 $\Omega(1/(n^2 C_{\mathsf{PI}}))$，其中 $C_{\mathsf{PI}}$ 是 $\mathcal{K}$ 上均匀分布 $\pi$ 的庞加莱常数。这意味着，从任意起始分布 $\pi_0$（其中 $M=\chi^2(\pi_{0}\,\|\,\pi)$）出发，击中-逃跑算法在 $O(n^2 C_{\mathsf{PI}}\log(M/\varepsilon))$ 步内收敛到与均匀分布 $\pi$ 的 $\chi^2$-散度小于 $\varepsilon$ 的分布，从而细化了 Lovász 和 Vempala (2004) 基于外半径 $R$ 的已知界 $O(n^2 R^2 \log(M/\varepsilon))$；对于近各向同性体，结合 KLS 猜想的进展，复杂度为 $O(n^2\log n\log(M/\varepsilon))$，将维度依赖性从立方改进到近二次，同时保持对初始距离的对数依赖性。将收敛性与庞加莱常数联系起来此前是一个开放问题。
tldr: 该论文证明了击中-逃跑算法的谱间隙下界与庞加莱常数相关，将收敛复杂度从立方维度依赖改进到近二次，并首次建立了与均匀分布谱性质的直接联系。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a spectral gap lower bound for Hit-and-Run tied to the Poincaré constant, improving convergence complexity from cubic to nearly quadratic dimension dependence and establishing the first direct connection to the uniform distribution's spectral properties.
